experiment_proposal.name: Distribution Inventory and External Demand Challenger
experiment_proposal.purpose: Test whether conservative ranges for accumulated inventory, effective external demand, possible distribution and remaining inventory add out-of-sample information about post-breakout continuation without pretending to identify a real actor's account or intent.

evidence_contract.observed: price, volume, turnover, VWAP, trade/aggressor proxies where available, order-book observations where available, official investor/program flows, market/sector context and source timestamps
evidence_contract.unknown: specific beneficial owner inventory, exact retail absorption, exact distribution quantity, intent, target price

forbidden_shortcuts: volume above estimated accumulation equals full exit
competing_hypotheses: market or sector beta reducing price elasticity
required_before_shadow: feature definitions frozen for first validation
required_before_production: adequate sample size defined before evaluation
fees/slippage where strategy use is tested
failure_conditions: precise inventory claims without identifiable data
feature redundancy adds maintenance cost without measurable gain
model encourages causal claims about actor intent
